newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee gains ground on low dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee gains ground on low dlr demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee regained lost ground and closed up on opening levels due to a lack of commercial or speculative demand for dollars, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.65 to the dollar, after opening at 57.70. The rupee closed at 57.65 on Friday.

"There was no import covering. Speculators were quiet despite low call rates because they were not sure if the rupee would fall further in the near-term, and it seemed that the dollar had peaked overseas," said a foreign bank dealer.
Overnight call money was at 12 percent with the market well offered. --Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
